record.one_liner: Podio is a no-code work management and CRM platform for building custom apps, items, workflows and client workspaces.
record.auth_notes: Docs describe four OAuth2-based flows (server-side, client-side, username and password, app authentication) all yielding an access token via api.podio.com/oauth/token/v2 using Client ID/Secret. critic: kept oauth2 only; app flow is documented as an OAuth2 flow, not a separately issued API key.
record.access_notes: Progress pricing page has a Free plan with API Integrations at 1000 calls per hour; developers register an application to get a Client ID and Client Secret. critic: access confirmed self_serve_free; no approval step found in docs.
record.api_notes: REST API at api.podio.com covering items, files, apps, workspaces, tasks etc. critic: breadth raised from moderate to broad (Podio API reference covers core objects with read/write); not graded.
record.blocker_notes: No app review or paid plan requirement found. Official MCP server (hosted by Progress/Podio) is in beta. critic: verdict confirmed.

evidence.quote: The Podio API uses the OAuth2 protocol for authentication.
Use app authentication if you only need to interact with a single Podio app and do not need to authenticate as a specific user.
Before you can use the Podio API you must register your application.
The server is live at https://mcp.podio.com
Your application is assigned a unique identifier, called "Client ID", together with a "Client Secret".
